questions.question: After finishing his long prayer at the temple, what did King Solomon do as he stood before all Israel?

answers.text: Blessed them in a loud voice
Read them the book of the law
Named his son the next king

questions.question: King Solomon asked God to uphold Israel's cause so that only Israel would know the LORD is God. True or false?
After King Solomon and all Israel offered huge sacrifices, what did they do to the house of the LORD?
Why were the people of Israel joyful as they went home from King Solomon's feast?

answers.text: For the good the LORD had done for David and Israel
For the gifts the king handed out to them
For the rain that finally came on the land
